content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

This is a self-hosted digital commerce system designed for creators in regions where traditional payment processors are restricted. It combines free and paid tools to create a fully operational online store. The core components include hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. By using cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin through NOWPayments, you bypass geographic restrictions and platform fees. The system is sovereign—you own and control every part of it. No third-party platform can shut you down or take a cut of your sales. This architecture is built for resilience, tested in environments where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, which is free and globally distributed. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring automated product delivery. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments processes cryptocurrency payments with a 0.5% fee, compared to Gumroad's 10%. For example, selling 100 ebooks at $97 each retains $921 more per month than using Gumroad. The system is webhook-driven: payment confirmation triggers instant product delivery. No manual intervention required. The architecture is modular, allowing you to swap components as needed without disrupting the entire system.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms are unavailable or unreliable. It’s also for creators who want to avoid platform fees and retain full control over their infrastructure. If you’re selling in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, or the Philippines, this stack is designed for you. It’s not a workaround—it’s a base-layer solution. You’re not renting infrastructure; you’re owning it. This system is pressure-tested in environments where financial isolation is a daily reality, ensuring it works where others fail.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction—Gumroad takes 10%. Retain $921 more on 100 sales of a $97 product.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, fast hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, automating order processing and file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files directly to customers. NOWPayments processes cryptocurrency payments with a 0.5% fee, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The system is webhook-driven, ensuring instant delivery upon payment confirmation. Each component is independent, so you can replace or upgrade parts without affecting the whole system. This modularity ensures long-term flexibility and scalability.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your hosting and backend tools. GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script are beginner-friendly, while Cloudflare Pages and Workers offer more advanced features. Set up NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments, and configure webhooks to trigger product delivery. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to store order data, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to host your files. Test the system end-to-end to ensure payments trigger instant delivery. Once deployed, you own the entire stack—no subscriptions, no platform fees. For a complete, step-by-step guide, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, saving you time and ensuring a smooth deployment.

NOWPayments charges just 0.5% per transaction, compared to Gumroad's 10%, saving you $921 on 100 sales of a $97 product.
